name: emitter
meaning: 3-slot inline emitter; factory 0x4b5896 takes its address at 0x4b58d0 and calls Emitter_Reset 0x52dbe3 at 0x4b58f7 BEFORE the final Dynamite vtable. 0x60 bytes, ending exactly at fuse +0xdc

name: fuse
meaning: remaining fuse in 1/4096 s ticks; decremented by g_dt while lit (state 3)

name: stateTimestamp
meaning: g_gameTime at the last state change (respawn wait 0x3000 ticks)

name: normalModel
meaning: model before the blast; its address is passed to InitWithAltModels at 0x4b5932

name: explodedModel
meaning: model after the blast; its address is passed to InitWithAltModels at 0x4b5923

name: homePos
meaning: spawn position; its address is taken at 0x4b518f, 0x4b553c, 0x4b57bf and 0x4b5819 (Init / Reset / HandleMessage)

name: soundHandle
meaning: stored Sound_Play handle: word reads at 0x4b4f26/0x4b4f34 (the Sound_Stop path), word writes at 0x4b4f53/0x4b544b/0x4b586d

name: state
meaning: 0 idle, 3 lit, 4 exploding, 5 hidden waiting 3 s, 6 fading back in

name: dynFlags
meaning: bit 0 set while the explosion model is shown
